mainEntity.name: Do I need an electrician for a bathroom lighting upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is strongly recommended to use a licensed electrician for a bathroom lighting upgrade, especially if it involves new wiring, moving fixtures, or installing GFCI (Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter) outlets. Electrical work in bathrooms is particularly critical due to the presence of water, requiring adherence to specific safety codes. Hometelligent Inc. ensures that all electrical installations comply with local building codes, mitigating risks and ensuring the long-term safety of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a licensed electrician is strongly recommended for bathroom lighting upgrades involving new wiring or moving fixtures due to critical safety codes, especially near water.
